```{r}
# ============================================================
# Project #3 - Part (1)
# 경험생명표(Complete Life Table) 작성
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. 데이터 불러오기
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pop <- read.csv(
  "시군구_성_연령_1세_별_주민등록연앙인구.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = 2,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "CP949"
)

names(pop)
head(pop)

death <- read.csv(
  "시도_성_연령_각세_별_사망자수.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = 1,
  fileEncoding = "CP949",
  check.names = FALSE
)

# 데이터 구조 확인
names(death)
head(death)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 0~99세 인구자료 P_x 추출
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pop_0_99 <- pop %>%
  filter(grepl("^[0-9]+세$", 연령별)) %>%
  mutate(
    age = as.numeric(sub("세", "", 연령별)),
    P_male = as.numeric(남자),
    P_female = as.numeric(여자)
  ) %>%
  filter(age <= 99) %>%
  select(age, P_male, P_female)

head(pop_0_99)
tail(pop_0_99)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. 0~99세 사망자수 D_x 추출
# ------------------------------------------------------------

death_0_99 <- death %>%
  filter(grepl("^[0-9]+세$", `연령(5세,각세)별`)) %>%
  mutate(
    age = as.numeric(sub("세", "", `연령(5세,각세)별`)),
    D_male = as.numeric(남자),
    D_female = as.numeric(여자)
  ) %>%
  filter(age <= 99) %>%
  select(age, D_male, D_female)

head(death_0_99)
tail(death_0_99)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. P_x와 D_x 결합
# ------------------------------------------------------------

data_2010 <- pop_0_99 %>%
  left_join(death_0_99, by = "age")

head(data_2010)

dim(data_2010)
summary(data_2010)


# ============================================================
# 5. 경험생명표 계산 함수
# ============================================================

make_life_table <- function(P, D, gender) {
  
  n <- length(P)
  
  # 0. 사망률
  m <- D / P
  
  # 1. 사망확률
  q <- m / (1 + m / 2)
  
  # 2. 생존자수
  l <- numeric(n + 1)
  l[1] <- 100000
  
  for (x in 1:n) {
    l[x + 1] <- l[x] * (1 - q[x])
  }
  
  # 3. 사망자수
  d <- l[1:n] - l[2:(n + 1)]
  
  # 4. 정지인구
  L <- (l[1:n] + l[2:(n + 1)]) / 2
  
  # 5. T_x
  T <- numeric(n)
  
  for (x in 1:n) {
    T[x] <- sum(L[x:n])
  }
  
  # 6. 기대여명
  e <- T / l[1:n]
  
  # 생명표
  life_table <- data.frame(
    gender = gender,
    age = 0:(n - 1),
    P_x = P,
    D_x = D,
    m_x = m,
    q_x = q,
    l_x = l[1:n],
    d_x = d,
    L_x = L,
    T_x = T,
    e_x = e
  )
  
  return(life_table)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. 남녀별 경험생명표 작성
# ------------------------------------------------------------

life_male <- make_life_table(
  P = data_2010$P_male,
  D = data_2010$D_male,
  gender = "Male"
)

life_female <- make_life_table(
  P = data_2010$P_female,
  D = data_2010$D_female,
  gender = "Female"
)

# 결과 확인
head(life_male)
head(life_female)


life_table <- bind_rows(
  life_male,
  life_female
)

head(life_table)


# ============================================================
# 9. 인구 피라미드
# ============================================================

pyramid_data <- pop_0_99 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(P_male, P_female),
    names_to = "sex",
    values_to = "population"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sex = recode(
      sex,
      P_male = "남자",
      P_female = "여자"
    ),
    population = ifelse(sex == "남자", -population, population)
  )

ggplot(pyramid_data,
       aes(x = age, y = population, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) format(abs(x), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2010년 남녀 연령별 인구 피라미드",
    x = "연령",
    y = "인구수",
    fill = "성별"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```



```{r}
official <- read.csv(
  "완전생명표_1세별.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = 1,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "CP949"
)

official_0_99 <- official %>%
  filter(grepl("^[0-9]+세$", 연령별)) %>%
  mutate(
    age = as.numeric(sub("세", "", 연령별))
  ) %>%
  filter(age <= 99)

life_table_official <- official_0_99 %>%
  select(
    age,
    
    q_male = `사망확률(남자)`,
    l_male = `생존자(남자)`,
    L_male = `정지인구(남자)`,
    e_male = `기대여명(남자) (년)`,
    
    q_female = `사망확률(여자)`,
    l_female = `생존자(여자)`,
    L_female = `정지인구(여자)`,
    e_female = `기대여명(여자) (년)`
  )

head(life_table_official)

# ============================================================
# 10. 계산값과 통계청 완전생명표 비교
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 남성 비교 데이터
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compare_male <- life_male %>%
  select(
    age,
    l_calculated = l_x,
    L_calculated = L_x,
    q_calculated = q_x,
    e_calculated = e_x
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    life_table_official %>%
      select(
        age,
        l_actual = l_male,
        L_actual = L_male,
        q_actual = q_male,
        e_actual = e_male
      ),
    by = "age"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 여성 비교 데이터
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compare_female <- life_female %>%
  select(
    age,
    l_calculated = l_x,
    L_calculated = L_x,
    q_calculated = q_x,
    e_calculated = e_x
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    life_table_official %>%
      select(
        age,
        l_actual = l_female,
        L_actual = L_female,
        q_actual = q_female,
        e_actual = e_female
      ),
    by = "age"
  )

head(compare_male)
head(compare_female)
```



